preview_virtual_readiness.identity: requirements[].partId or requirements[].coilId when formally resolved; otherwise unresolvedRequirements[]
preview_virtual_readiness.truncation: Collections are response-complete only when their formal complete field is true; incomplete results remain incomplete.

check_order_readiness.identity: shortages[].partId or shortages[].coilId when the planner has a formal material binding
check_order_readiness.unresolved: A part/coil requirement without canonical ID remains an unresolved requirement and cannot become a canonical shortage fact.

get_order_detail.identity: resolved order binding; order items preserve recipeName only as an order snapshot
get_order_detail.snapshotBoundary: An order-line recipe snapshot is not promoted to CURRENT_CANONICAL_RECIPE.

get_purchase_overview.identity: tasks[].partId or tasks[].coilId when carried by the formal purchase plan
get_purchase_overview.supplier: supplier is a formal string attribute, not a new Supplier entity.
